assessments.summary: The pinned checker’s successful execution certifies 152 distinct points in the 76×76 grid and exhaustively verifies that every triple has nonzero determinant. Since this grid embeds in the 77×77 grid, the argument establishes D(77) ≥ 152.
scopeQualifications: The attestation establishes acceptance of the pinned bytes by the pinned checker in the governed execution; the checker audit separately establishes the mathematical adequacy of that verification.
The claim does not establish optimality, D(77)=152, or a new lower bound beyond the existing 152-point record.
The assertion that the artifacts are byte-for-byte identical to an earlier contribution is unverified here, but is provenance-only and unnecessary for the lower bound.
